topology.negative_source: 916 real IEDB nonbinding outcomes plus 87848 synthetic negatives (cross-paired TCRs with a different epitope they were never reported to bind), labelled is_synthetic_negative in the source CSV; the package data files keep the flag in train/validation so solvers can stratify, but test_inputs.csv must NOT reveal it (see build_splits.py)
topology.source: IEDB AIRR export (tcr_full_airr.tsv, Nov 3 2026 build), human TRA/TRB, peptidic epitopes 8-15 AA, deduplicated, capped 1000/epitope, synthetic negatives 1:1 per epitope (see data/DATA_CARD.md and SPLIT_EVIDENCE.md)
topology.split_key: epitope_sequence: train, validation and test epitopes are disjoint by exact sequence, and train epitopes within edit distance <= 2 / 3-mer Jaccard >= 0.60 of any held-out epitope were removed (6 epitopes, 2604 rows)
